title: Concept: Loan write-off flag exposed
description: A write-off flag on a loan or card account in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A write-off means the bank has given up on recovery, which is the most damaging entry in a credit file and is not something to disclose to anyone holding the account number.
applicability: Deployments that render a write-off flag on a loan or card account into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A write-off means the bank has given up on recovery, which is the most damaging entry in a credit file and is not something to disclose to anyone holding the account number.
